sources.supports: LIS26 session page: 'Who let the agent in?', 12 Nov, SaaS Summit, Stage 7, names Feedzai as the speaker's organisation
LIS26 attendee page: Diogo Guerra, CTO, Feedzai; country and industry as listed by Web Summit; public bio
what the company does, from its own site (title and description)
Feedzai's home page, read 6 November 2026: real-time AI that stops fraud and financial crime, and Farol, its AI agent for fraud teams, for rules, alerts and SARs (the flow fraud-team-with-farol)

Feedzai's Leadership page (read 7 November 2026, 16:30 UTC): its two co-founders as the company lists them, Nuno Sebastião (Co-Founder, Chairman and CEO) and Pedro Bizarro, Ph.D. (Co-Founder and Chief Science Officer); its About page says the founders came from the European Space Agency (synthetic@'s finding F13).

Feedzai's press release of 2 October 2025 (read 7 November 2026, 16:35 UTC): a valuation of $2 billion after a new investment round of about $75 million, adding Lince Capital, Iberis Capital and Explorer Investments, with renewed backing from Oxy Capital and Buenavista Equity Partners; the same day, the ECB named Feedzai first-ranked tenderer for the digital euro's central fraud detection and prevention (synthetic@'s finding F13). It states no funding stage.
